title: Growing and changing
examples: What is the biggest change my body will go through?
When do I start to change from a child to a teenager?
Does growing up mean I get stronger in every way?

explain.say: When we are babies, our bodies are very small.
As children, our bodies grow bigger and stronger every day.
Teenagers experience big changes as they move toward adulthood.
Adult bodies are fully developed and can do many things.
Growth means that your body changes in size and function over time.
When you are a baby, you learn to crawl and eventually walk.

faq.q: Does puberty mean my body changes very fast?
faq.a: Yes, puberty brings many noticeable changes to your body. It is a natural part of growing up to adulthood.
asks: Why do my body parts change suddenly?

faq.q: Is it normal for my friends and me to grow at different rates?
faq.a: It is completely normal for people to grow at different times. Everyone's body develops on its own schedule.
asks: Do I have to grow at the same speed as others?
Is there a right time to grow?

faq.q: What causes my body to get stronger as I get older?
faq.a: Getting stronger comes from a mix of good nutrition and regular physical activity. These things help your muscles and bones grow.
asks: How do I make my body stronger?

faq.q: Are the changes in my voice normal when I am a teenager?
faq.a: Yes, changes in your voice are a very common and normal part of puberty. Your vocal cords are changing as you grow.
asks: Why does my voice sound different now?
Is my voice changing because of puberty?

faq.q: What is the main difference between a child and an adult?
faq.a: The main difference is that adults have reached full physical maturity. Children are still developing many skills and bodily functions.
asks: When am I considered an adult?

faq.q: Do I need to eat special foods to grow up well?
faq.a: Eating a balanced diet with many different food groups is important for growth. This gives your body the energy and materials it needs.
asks: What should I eat to grow big?
Is food the only thing needed for growth?

faq.q: How long does the growing process take?
faq.a: The process of growing takes many years, from infancy right through to adulthood. It is a continuous process.
asks: Does growing stop when I am a certain age?
How long does it take to become an adult?

facts: Babies are completely dependent on caregivers for all needs.
Children develop motor skills like walking and writing over time.
Teenagers undergo puberty, which causes many physical changes.
Adult bodies are considered fully developed for most daily tasks.

quiz.say: When is a person's body generally at its smallest and most dependent?
quiz.why: Babies are at the very beginning of development and are very small.

wrong.0: Adults are fully developed, not the smallest stage.
wrong.2: Children are already growing and learning many new things.
wrong.3: Teenagers are undergoing major changes, not the smallest stage.

quiz.say: Which stage involves significant changes like voice deepening?
quiz.why: The teenager stage is when puberty causes noticeable physical changes.

wrong.1: Babies do not experience voice changes like that.
wrong.2: Children's bodies are still developing, but not with puberty changes.
wrong.3: Adult bodies have already passed the major puberty changes.

quiz.say: If a person is learning to ride a bike, which stage are they most likely in?
quiz.why: Learning complex skills like riding a bike happens as a child develops.

wrong.1: Babies cannot ride a bicycle yet.
wrong.2: While teenagers can ride, the initial learning of basic skills is characteristic of childhood.
wrong.3: Adults are generally expected to have mastered these skills.
